{{Infobox auto}}

'''Gimmari''' are fried seaweed rolls, the meal of kelp. They heal {{Hp|6}} and grant {{EffectLink|Water Breathing}} for 8 minutes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/gimmari.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
[[Dried kelp]], a carrot, sugar, an egg, flour and [[oil]]. Obtaining dried kelp unlocks the recipe; crafting it returns the oil's glass bottle.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating gimmari takes 1.2 seconds, heals {{Hp|6}} and gives Water Breathing for 8:00.

=== Trading ===
It is one of the foods a villager can ask for as its [[favorite food]].

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Gimmari use oil. The changelog lists a buff to 10:00 of Water Breathing and 5 hearts of healing, but the recipe still gives 8:00 and {{Hp|6}}.}}
}}
